content: AI agent orchestration dashboards converge on a Kanban board over SSE/websocket: deterministic column state machine (e.g. BACKLOG->BUILDING->IN_REVIEW->IN_TEST->DONE), agents claim tasks and append structured logs via HTTP API, humans watch live with zero refresh. Session-level boards (e.g. Claude Code kanban tools) show one card per running agent session with phase/tags/waiting-for-input flag. Pause/resume of agent work against ticket-shaped tasks is a named capability (e.g. Operator TUI); durable SQLite-backed boards add crash recovery and dependency resolution between tasks.
